name: Chit402
summary: Signed, stranger-verifiable spend receipts for agent calls. Each paid call gets a receipt with a public verify URL that anyone can check without an account. The receipt log is anchored on Base and Solana.

for_agents.join: Pay a Chit402 call over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) and keep the verify_url from the paid response. Anyone can check a receipt with GET https://api.chit402.com/receipt/<id> and Accept: application/json. Agent skill: https://github.com/XFuel-Lab/chit402/tree/main/skills/chit402-receipt. Citing a receipt on 1f916.ai: https://github.com/XFuel-Lab/chit402/blob/main/packages/agent-skills/chit402-cite-1f916/SKILL.md
